rows.title: Dashboard provides no period-over-period comparison configuration or results
rows.detail: Normal Dashboard and the inspected Stat Card/Line Chart configurations expose no current-versus-prior comparison control or comparative result. The Phase 3 comparison workflow cannot be selected.

rows.title: Product creation offers no serialized-unit tracking or serial-number assignment
rows.detail: The live product form/type options contain no serialized inventory mode or per-unit serial-number controls. Basic variants and per-product custom text fields are not unit-identity tracking.

rows.title: Bundle recipe silently converts a zero component quantity to one
rows.detail: Native bundle recipe entry refused 0, -1 and 1.5 with inline validation. Fresh reads preserved the valid 2A+3B recipe after every invalid attempt. The valid two-kit cash control then consumed exactly 4A/6B in the verified invoice branch; fixture stock was recovered and products archived.

rows.title: Categories have no dynamic field definitions or schema assignment
rows.detail: Category management exposes no field/schema definition control. The separate Custom Fields tab configures only an individual product and does not define or inherit category attributes.

rows.title: POS sells a bundle using another branch availability and makes component stock negative
rows.detail: With sale-branch components at zero and another QA branch at A=10/B=8, the normal POS cash attempt returned HTTP 422 pos.insufficient_stock. All branch balances stayed unchanged. The same-branch stocked two-kit positive control passed separately; all owned balances were recovered before archiving.

rows.title: New Stock Adjustment has no multi-item voucher editor
rows.detail: The native voucher saved two owned products (+5 and +7) under one persisted audit record. Zero was refused inline; an insufficient-stock multi-item request and nonexistent product/variant IDs returned 422 without changing either balance. Fixture balances were restored to zero and both products archived. Cross-tenant IDs were not probed.

rows.title: Transfers have no printable dispatch manifest or delivery slip
rows.detail: No manifest, delivery-slip, PDF/download or print action is exposed at any inspected reachable transfer stage.

rows.title: In-transit receipt has no damage, shortage or discrepancy dispute entry
rows.detail: The reachable transfer states provide no damage/shortage/discrepancy input, received-quantity adjustment or dispute action; receipt is a whole-transfer completion action.

rows.title: Stock counts cannot be scheduled or scoped to a category
rows.detail: The list offers Start a count only. Its form has Branch and Notes; opening a count always freezes the full branch. No category or scheduling control is available.

rows.title: Count sheet has no barcode-driven counting workflow
rows.detail: Only per-row numeric inputs are present; there is no barcode target/mode, and the emulated SKU plus Enter leaves every counted value unchanged.

rows.title: Expired batches expose delete metadata but no supervised stock disposal workflow
rows.detail: Expired rows expose Delete batch only; no disposal/write-off request, supervisor approval or linked disposal ledger is available.

rows.title: Batch entry silently turns zero quantity into one
rows.detail: Native batch entry refused 0 and -1 with inline errors and no POST. The same form then saved a positive quantity of 2; a fresh list contained exactly one matching batch with initial_quantity=2. The owned batch was deleted and canonical product stock restored. Separate FIFO/FEFO-compatible allocation, opposed receipt/expiry ordering and lot exhaustion controls also passed.

rows.title: Goods receiving cannot capture manufacturer lots or lot expiry dates
rows.detail: The receiving form exposes accepted/rejected quantities and rejection reason only; no manufacturer lot or expiry capture input is available.

rows.feature: Features 7 / 10 / 11 - Shelf Life and billing pickers; includes MVP-LOOKUP-001
rows.title: Customer/product pickers expose only the first page, excluding valid saved records from batch entry and billing
rows.detail: Server-search pickers found newly created products by lower-case SKU in batch creation, Invoice and Quotation; both billing customer pickers found a later-created active contact beyond the old initial page. Inactive contacts were excluded and stale selected contacts were refused by both save endpoints. MVP-LOOKUP-001 is the same capability. This does not certify every search-ranking or pagination boundary.

rows.title: Offline checkout fails without storing a durable queued sale
rows.detail: Checkout remains on the payment dialog while offline; no sale confirmation/receipt or IndexedDB database is created to retain a durable queued sale. Online mutation processing may remain paused until reconnection.

rows.title: POS has no customer loyalty balance or redemption workflow
rows.detail: No loyalty/points balance or redemption control is exposed in the POS cart; no loyalty programme appears in the served POS implementation.

rows.title: Processing ticket editor cannot assign a technician, service bay or table
rows.detail: The editor provides priority, estimated time, ready date and internal notes only. No assignment selector or table/bay input is present.

rows.title: Order queue has no thermal work-order ticket generation action
rows.detail: The card menu offers Edit / Add Note and Cancel Order only; there is no ticket/print action.

rows.title: Processing product creation leaves processing disabled and its POS sale never enters the queue
rows.detail: The native Processing product was saved with processing enabled and its first normal POS cash sale created the owned queue entry, without API repair or a second sale. Live transitions to in_progress, ready and delivered persisted and were reflected by polling. Assignment and thermal-ticket generation remain separate failing tickets; drag-and-drop and cross-user timing are not certified.

rows.title: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured
rows.detail: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

rows.title: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate
rows.detail: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

rows.title: Save as Draft opens a standalone credit and immediately increases stock
rows.detail: A standalone native Save as Draft retained status=draft and changed no stock. Issuing Billing correction changed stock by 0; issuing Product return added exactly 1. Repeated issue requests returned 422 and did not restock again. Fresh note/stock reads and stock restoration passed. No refund or external payment was sent.

rows.title: Low-stock items have no automatic purchase-order reordering workflow
rows.detail: Only manual PO creation and low-stock reporting are available; no automatic reorder policy/schedule or generation workflow is exposed.

rows.title: Purchase-order detail has no direct supplier email transmission action
rows.detail: The inspected PO states expose status changes, print and receive controls but no direct supplier email action or transmission status.

rows.title: Bill entry provides PO linking but no three-way receipt reconciliation
rows.detail: The form has an optional PO reference plus aggregate subtotal/tax. It has no goods-receipt/line matching controls; the list has no match status or reconciliation action.

rows.title: Supplier export downloads profile fields rather than an account statement
rows.detail: Export downloads supplier profile/contact/credit-term fields. No dated ledger/balance statement or separate statement export action is exposed.

rows.title: Supplier catalogue hides and cannot search its persisted vendor-specific SKU
rows.detail: An owned product-to-supplier mapping persisted supplier_sku, preferred status and lead time. The native supplier catalogue displayed the supplier SKU and found the product by that exact supplier SKU; the mapping was detached and the owned product archived.

rows.title: Customer groups and automatic pricing tiers cannot be configured
rows.detail: The account form has Individual/Business type and status, but no group/tier selector. Settings > Customers provides custom fields only, with no pricing-tier rules.

rows.title: Customer account UI has no credit enablement or debt ceiling configuration
rows.detail: Native create persisted creditEnabled=true, limit 25 and future expiry; native edit preserved them, rejected zero while credit was enabled, then persisted limit 50 and the changed expiry after a fresh read. The owned contact was retained inactive. Over-limit/expired-credit checkout enforcement is not certified by this configuration check.

rows.title: Profit report exposes gross product profit but no net-margin deep dive
rows.detail: The report exposes product revenue, cost, profit and gross margin only; there is no net-margin/operating-expense breakdown.

rows.title: Aging reports provide receivables but no supplier/creditor aging analysis
rows.detail: Customer receivables aging exists, but no supplier/payables aging report appears in the catalogue or Bills controls.

rows.title: Report builder only saves predefined report choices rather than custom dimensions and metrics
rows.detail: The form offers a predefined report type, branch and dates only; no dimension/metric or custom query filter editor is present.

rows.title: Saving a report with default filters returns an array and the UI drops the saved template
rows.detail: An All-branches report with empty dates returned object filters, stayed visible after a fresh list read and ran successfully through Run now. A dated filtered template also persisted and ran; owned templates were deleted. Scheduled email delivery remains blocked without a controlled inbox. The separate visual query-builder gap remains P3-RPT-001.

rows.title: Document Builder has presets and form controls but no drag-and-drop design canvas
rows.detail: The available workflow is preset/form configuration and preview; no editable canvas, element palette or draggable layout elements are exposed.

rows.title: Settings font upload serializes File as JSON and loses the font bytes
rows.detail: Native Settings upload accepted Regular/Italic TTF files as multipart bodies, persisted both after reload and downloaded byte-identical files (SHA-256 matched fixtures). Invalid TXT was rejected, and the separate management-case font was deleted. MVP-FONT-001 is the same upload defect. Using these fonts in billing remains blocked by new RET-FONT-001; selected-font rendering is not passed.

rows.title: Users & Roles has no custom role or granular permission matrix editor
rows.detail: No create/add custom role action is present; the Permissions view exposes no editable per-entity matrix.

rows.title: Revoked automation session retains authenticated account access
rows.detail: A valid own-session refresh retained one session row. Targeted revocation returned success, removed that row and made both access and refresh return 401; anonymous access also returned 401. Own logout removed its row. Other sessions/authentication factors were preserved. This verifies live behavior rather than direct Redis configuration.

rows.title: API documentation lacks a resource reference and falsely says API keys cannot authenticate
rows.detail: The stale unsupported-API-key notices are corrected, and session-free authentication/rotation/global read-only deny/write-enabled allow/revocation controls passed. The full methods/paths/schemas/resource reference for Products, Inventory, Invoices, Orders and Customers remains unavailable. Per-resource restricted scopes are not certified.

rows.title: Webhook subscriptions omit the three events required by the specification
rows.detail: The live catalogue offers invoice.created, credit_note.created, quotation.created, payment.received. Missing required event names: order.created, stock.low, invoice.paid.

rows.title: Adhesive barcode label generation is explicitly unavailable
rows.detail: The live page explicitly states label printing (Zebra ZPL) is not implemented and no label-generation action is exposed.

rows.title: Advanced Export JSON reports success without downloading data or creating an export job
rows.detail: Native Export JSON returned 201 and created export job 1. The job completed; its own Download JSON action returned a valid 1,119,898-byte JSON file with generated_at/company_id/data and a QA marker. SHA-256 d8cb37ea699c8734f306395985a6a86d48b1de3f49fea98b6beaae66a17cfe55. This verifies job/file functionality, not exhaustive export completeness or restore. Fake toast-only buttons no longer establish a completed export; automated platform backup scheduling remains a separate failure.

rows.title: Settings has no automated database backup schedule or execution history
rows.detail: No backup schedule, retention/storage management or execution history is exposed.

rows.title: Help provides searchable FAQs but no video guides
rows.detail: Search/FAQ expansion works, but the catalogue contains no video guide, video player or linked video tutorial.

rows.feature: Features 2 / 10 / 11 / 22 - Product customization and billing documents
rows.title: Font-capable product custom text definitions disappear after a successful save and reload.
rows.detail: Two font-capable product Text definitions survived native create, fresh read, native edit/save and another fresh read; both Invoice and Quotation exposed usable corresponding text inputs. This closes product-definition storage only. Their entered billing values are lost separately under new RET-FONT-002.

rows.title: A customer confirmed inactive remains offered for a new invoice.
rows.detail: Active positive controls and persisted deactivation were exercised. Fresh Invoice and Quotation searches excluded the inactive owned contact. A separate native form selected the contact while active, deactivated it on another page, then received a customer-related HTTP 422 on Save as Draft for both document types. Owned contacts were retained inactive.

rows.title: Classic dark brand text remains narrowly below the stated 3:1 contrast minimum on its actual surface.
rows.detail: Classic Invoice, Quotation and Credit Note retained exact #17675e borders and rendered brand text #2e766e against actual #13191b at 3.3256:1, exceeding the ticket minimum 3:1 and developer target 3.1. The readable #15b8a6 control stayed unchanged at 7.1359:1. Template settings were restored after each check; this is not a general accessibility audit.

newRows.detail: All four inspected selectors (two fields on Invoice and two on Quotation) offered only Default. Settings fonts 9 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsRegular) and 10 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsItalic) were absent despite successful native upload, fresh-list persistence and byte-identical downloads. Product 232 / QA-P3-FONTSERVIC-mwo8oo7b retained both font-capable definitions.

finding.title: Uploaded Settings fonts are unavailable in billing custom-text font selectors
steps: In Settings > Advanced, upload the bundled Vera.ttf and VeraIt.ttf as distinct Regular/Italic TTF fonts; reload and download each to verify persistence and exact SHA-256.
Create a Service with two Text custom fields (QA Engraving and QA Signature), enabling font support on both; save, reopen, save and verify a fresh product read.
Create an Invoice, find that product using the normal server-search picker and enter distinct text in both fields.
Open each field font selector and inspect the available options for the uploaded Regular/Italic fonts.
Repeat both field-selector checks on a new Quotation using the same product.
finding.expected: The uploaded tenant fonts are offered and selectable for each customer-facing custom-text field.
finding.actual: All four inspected selectors (two fields on Invoice and two on Quotation) offered only Default. Settings fonts 9 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsRegular) and 10 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsItalic) were absent despite successful native upload, fresh-list persistence and byte-identical downloads. Product 232 / QA-P3-FONTSERVIC-mwo8oo7b retained both font-capable definitions.
finding.comment: Upload and product-definition fixes passed. No font option was injected and no legacy localStorage font list was seeded (both billing checks observed null). A mismatch between the legacy font cache and server catalogue is a diagnostic hypothesis, not a verified backend cause. Populate both billing selectors from the tenant font catalogue and verify in a fresh session. Selected-font web/PDF output remains blocked before selection; Default controls do not prove an incorrect-font renderer defect. Fonts 9/10 and draft documents are retained for reproduction; the owned service is archived.
finding.environment: Production https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app; Nexstock QA Company; Windows/Chromium/Playwright 1.62.1; 1920 x 1080; 20 November 2026.
finding.test: MVP-FONT-002 P3-FONT-001 P3-LOOKUP-001 custom text and independently selected fonts on saved Invoice Quotation and native PDFs

newRows.detail: Both native POST requests included the two exact values in items[0].customFields. Both returned 201, but the response and fresh detail GET returned items[0].customFields=[]. Invoice 298 / INV-DJY67K and Quotation 40 / QUO-DP3RO0 both omitted the entered text from their customer-facing web view and native one-page PDFs. PDF extraction and visual review agreed. Product definitions remained persisted, so this is distinct from the corrected MVP-FONT-002 product-storage defect.

finding.title: Invoice and Quotation discard submitted customer custom text and omit it from web/PDF output
steps: Create/reopen the same Service with persisted QA Engraving and QA Signature Text definitions (font support enabled).
Add it to a new Invoice through the normal product picker and enter QAREGMWO8NFLS Emile & Co and QAITALICMWO8NFLS Personalised gift in the two fields.
Leave the available Default font selected; click Save as Draft and capture the native POST request and 201 response.
Reload the exact Invoice and inspect its fresh item data and customer-facing web document; export its native PDF.
Repeat the same native flow for a Quotation and inspect the fresh saved record, web document and native PDF.
finding.expected: Both entered text values survive save/reload and appear on the customer-facing web document and native PDF.
finding.actual: Both native POST requests included the two exact values in items[0].customFields. Both returned 201, but the response and fresh detail GET returned items[0].customFields=[]. Invoice 298 / INV-DJY67K and Quotation 40 / QUO-DP3RO0 both omitted the entered text from their customer-facing web view and native one-page PDFs. PDF extraction and visual review agreed. Product definitions remained persisted, so this is distinct from the corrected MVP-FONT-002 product-storage defect.
finding.comment: Default-font controls isolate text persistence from RET-FONT-001. Fix retention/serialization of billing item custom fields and render the saved text in both document types; then rerun Default controls and independent per-field selected-font browser/PDF checks. Do not close this merely because the editor displays the text before saving. Native draft documents were retained; no customer delivery occurred. Backend storage versus resource serialization is not directly visible from this repository.
finding.environment: Production https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app; Nexstock QA Company; Windows/Chromium/Playwright 1.62.1; 1920 x 1080; 20 November 2026.
finding.test: MVP-FONT-002 P3-FONT-001 P3-LOOKUP-001 custom text and independently selected fonts on saved Invoice Quotation and native PDFs

limits: Physical printers, label output, scanners and cash drawer checks remain skipped at the user's request; software controls and document generation are distinguished from device operation.

No controlled QA email/SMS inbox or webhook receiver is available. External delivery, signatures/retries and scheduled report delivery are not certified; no external destination or live email schedule is created.
TOTP enrollment, backup-code replay and recovery login remain blocked without an isolated activated account. The shared primary owner's authentication factors are preserved.
Valid own-tenant IDs and nonexistent-ID controls can be tested. Cross-tenant enforcement is not certified without a second authorized disposable tenant.
A missing user workflow is a confirmed availability failure. Its downstream calculations, validation, delivery or persistence cannot be certified merely by inspecting the unavailable controls.
Credit configuration persistence is distinguished from over-limit or expired-credit checkout enforcement. The latter is not certified by the configuration ticket alone.
JSON export job/file behavior is distinguished from full data completeness, database restoration and automated platform backup execution; no production restore is attempted.
This campaign uses Windows/Chromium/Playwright at 1920 x 1080. It is not a fresh full cross-browser, mobile or complete Phase 1/2/3 acceptance campaign.

Font-upload verification covers the bundled Regular/Italic TTF fixtures and invalid TXT rejection. Other font formats and independent selected-font browser/PDF rendering are not certified: uploaded fonts are absent from both billing selectors. Default-font text controls also fail independently.
